caption: The drawing features a rectangular composition with a prominent diagonal division. In the upper right and right border areas, there is an ornate floral design composed of black, green, red, pink, purple, and yellow elements. The floral motifs include detailed leaves, stems, and a variety of flowers scattered and interwoven, with larger central flowers and smaller blossoms and buds, all on a cream or light beige background. Encircling this section is a border of repeated oval shapes with green centers edged in red, each enclosed by a black outline and separated by red dots. On the left and lower sections, there is a zigzag pattern created from a patchwork of diamond-shaped pieces, each decorated with intricate designs and filled with colors such as red, yellow, green, black, pink, and purple, appearing in repeated, alternating arrangements. Each diamond contains miniature floral or abstract patterns. The two main sections—the floral motif and the zigzag pattern—are separated by a scalloped, black-edged boundary line. The overall color palette is dominated by shades of green, red, black, pink, yellow, and white, with detailed line work and fills in multiple hues.
title: Patchwork and Applique Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
